creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-10-16 after a_2hL5I8kn2. On 2026-10-14 an urgent ring typed into a busy Claude Code worker sat unsent for 14 minutes because every look at its prompt, while it ran cargo test, found no prompt to read. Why is not established: nothing logged the reason and the screen was not kept. Since 2026-10-16 the doorbell logs msg.ring.covered once per ring, with the reason. At the next sighting, read that line and the screen, and fix detection if a Claude Code working screen hides its prompt box.
title: Read why an urgent ring found no prompt while a worker ran long cargo builds
